name: Compound Astragalus Recipe
short: Only one 3-month trial in 60 people with myasthenia gravis (30 on the formula): no adverse reactions were found with the formula; 5 on prednisone had a temporary rise in liver enzymes.
text: The only safety evidence found is one randomized trial in 60 people with myasthenia gravis, in which 30 took Compound Astragalus Recipe and 30 took prednisone (a steroid medicine) for 3 months, with adverse reactions monitored. No adverse reaction was found in the formula group, while 5 people in the prednisone group had a temporary moderate rise in the liver enzymes ALT and AST in the second week. The trial is small and short, and the abstract does not list the herbs in the formula. No interaction data were found in the cited source.
